prompts.atlas: Use case: stylized-concept. Production fighting-game sprite atlas. Use the attached image as the character identity reference. Create exactly twelve complete full-body poses of the SAME ADULT FEMALE professional wrestler. Match face, hair, muscular athletic proportions, intact opaque sports costume, colors and detailed bold cel-shaded cartoon linework. Transparent background with genuine alpha. Strict 3 columns by 4 rows, portrait 1536x2048 canvas. One isolated complete wrestler in each equal-size cell, generous transparent margins, absolutely no overlaps or clipping, no labels or grid or floor shadows, no opponent or props. All poses face screen RIGHT, consistent head size and anatomical scale across poses. All two arms and two legs visible. Row 1: ready balanced upright fighting stance; windup with deep weight shift and elbow cocked behind; forceful horizontal elbow strike right. Row 2: fully extended high side kick right; low wrestling clinch reaching both hands forward; overhead powerbomb lift with wide planted legs and both hands high. Row 3: low sit-out slam landing legs spread forward hands driving downward; backward-arched suplex wrestling bridge with hips high head and feet grounded; seated armbar legs extending right and both hands pulling toward chest. Row 4: seated twisting ankle lock hands clasped around imaginary ankle; standing defensive forearm guard; pronounced full-body impact recoil backward knees bent arms flung out. These are dynamic cohesive single whole-character drawings, no separate body parts. CHARACTER IDENTITY: Short copper orange asymmetrical hair, powerful muscular tan body, black and orange sports bra and short trunks, black fingerless gloves, black-orange knee pads and tall lace-up boots.
